title: Validate governed resources
summary: Performs a complete policy, schema, record, liveness, and cross-record resource review with explicit coverage and separately confirmed fixes.

intent.goal: Produce one evidence-backed drift report that distinguishes checked, skipped, unknown, adjacent, and fixable findings without guessing facts.
useWhen: The complete configured Resources set needs policy and reality validation.
excludeWhen: Only schema documentation, one known record edit, or a new resource capture is requested.

procedure.outcome: Acquire the exact policy, live schema, target mapping, and complete configured resource set.
requirements: Bind every input and observation to one exact governed source or explicit operator decision.
stopConditions: Stop when required evidence, authority, or an exact prerequisite is unavailable.

safeguards: Never silently sample a complete-sweep request.

Behavior evidence and effects remain scoped to exact governed development requests and current workflow fingerprints.
